name: ProteinLMBench-Reason
description: Large language models (LLMs) show promise for protein analysis, yet existing resources rarely provide structured, fact-grounded explanations that support scientific interpretation of model outputs. Protein-specific datasets containing such explanations remain scarce. We present an automated pipeline for constructing protein-specific question-answer (QA) data with model-generated explanatory rationales conditioned on curated UniProtKB/Swiss-Prot annotations. From 572,619 source protein entries, the pipeline generated 1,932,728 candidate QA pairs and retained 14,044 after automated filtering; 700 retained pairs form ProteinLMBench-Reason. In matched-input evaluations, QwQ-32B fine-tuned on the template-based data achieved higher final-answer reference-overlap scores than the evaluated baselines, whereas differences in source-conditioned consistency measured by AlignScore and SummaC-Conv were smaller and baseline-dependent. ProteinLMDataset-Reason therefore provides a resource for supervised training and benchmarking of protein-specific explanatory QA.
